courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 哥本哈根地鐵環狀線
related.transfer: 可遷移「通風散熱與設備溫升」與「垂直動線有效輸送率」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；哥本哈根地鐵環狀線的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Ventilation cooling and equipment heat" and "Vertical circulation throughput" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Copenhagen Cityringen must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦沙漠都市自動捷運熱管理與高架介面；哥本哈根地鐵環狀線則以環狀自動捷運循環班表與深層車站為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on desert urban automated metro thermal and elevated interfaces; Copenhagen Cityringen centres on automated orbital metro cycles and deep stations, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「通風散熱與設備溫升」與「單圈週期與車隊需求」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到哥本哈根地鐵環狀線，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat” and “Loop cycle and fleet requirement”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Copenhagen Cityringen, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Tunnel air exchange and dilution time", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 杜拜地鐵紅線
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2009 年：杜拜地鐵紅線於九月開始旅客服務；2021 年：杜拜地鐵與電車營運維護交由新營運團隊。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以杜拜地鐵紅線為背景，建立高架路段、空調車站與自動列車組成的教學系統。學徒需在砂塵、強日照與尖峰旅客並存時辨認冷卻及濾材維護瓶頸，並檢查旅客轉乘路徑和緊急供電對服務恢復的影響。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2009: Dubai Metro Red Line began passenger service in September; 2021: A new operating team took over Dubai Metro and Tram operations and maintenance. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Dubai Metro Red Line to construct a teaching system with elevated sections, conditioned stations and automated trains. Under dust, intense sunlight and peak arrivals, identify cooling and filter-maintenance bottlenecks. Examine how transfer paths and emergency power affect service restoration, keeping outdoor weather observations separate from measured equipment and rail temperatures. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.
